verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is API-first: a JSON REST API with SDKs in many languages, non-interactive ECDSA key-based request signing handled by the SDKs, IP-allowlisted credentials, and a self-serve Sandbox where moving to Production only means changing the base URL and credentials. Together these let it run headlessly in automated pipelines and test against the Sandbox in CI. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guidance or examples, an official CLI for scripted use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
